arc.destination: The chain across the street closes — because Dana and Mo accidentally out-community it.
acts: Dana obsesses over beating the chain through schemes while Mo accidentally creates genuine community moments
Their organic warmth starts attracting locals while Dana's plans backfire; the chain notices and retaliates
Dana realizes the shop won won by being real, not strategic; the chain closes as customers choose connection over convenience

episodes.title: Soft Open, Hard Feelings
episodes.premise: Dana declares war when the chain opens across the street with a flash mob. Mo suggests they just make good coffee.
episodes.arc_beat: Establishes the rivalry and Dana's need to compete; Mo's philosophy plants the seed of what will actually work

episodes.title: The Loyalty Card Incident
episodes.premise: Dana launches an aggressive loyalty program with increasingly desperate rewards. Mo accidentally creates a regular by remembering someone's name.
episodes.arc_beat: Dana's scheme fails; Mo's genuine attention earns their first true regular (establishes pattern: real beats tactical)

episodes.title: Influencer Outreach
episodes.premise: Dana forces Mo to help stage the perfect Instagram shot. The photo flops, but Mo's visible annoyance in the background goes viral as a meme.
episodes.arc_beat: The shop gains unexpected visibility for being authentic/unpolished; locals start coming in referencing 'that meme place'

episodes.title: The Chain Strikes Back
episodes.premise: The chain copies their menu and undercuts prices. Dana spirals until Mo points out their customers didn't leave.
episodes.arc_beat: The threat escalates but the community they've built holds; Dana first glimpses that connection matters more than competition

episodes.title: Community Board
episodes.premise: Dana reluctantly lets locals use their wall for flyers after Mo already said yes. The wall becomes the neighborhood hub, cramping Dana's aesthetic but filling the shop.
episodes.arc_beat: The shop transforms into genuine community space; Dana wrestles with losing control while gaining what she actually wanted

episodes.title: Closed for Business
episodes.premise: The chain shutters overnight; Dana expects triumph but feels empty. Mo reveals the chain's regional manager now comes in for their coffee — they won by being somewhere worth going.
episodes.arc_beat: Victory arrives quietly; Dana accepts they succeeded by accident through humanity, not strategy; the rivalry ends with unexpected grace
